rounds.text: Hindustan Construction Company is currently undergoing a significant financial transformation, evidenced by a robust 366% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21] and a strong 24.8% ROCE [E12]. The company has successfully deleveraged, reducing borrowings from Rs 1,679 Cr to Rs 1,019 Cr in a single year [E37], while simultaneously generating substantial free cash flow of Rs 825 Cr [E33]. This operational efficiency is further validated by a cash conversion ratio of 5.37x, confirming that reported profits are fully backed by actual cash [E31]. Institutional confidence is shifting, as evidenced by foreign institutions increasing their stake from 5.58% to 11.38% [E40] and positive net institutional money flow [E42]. Conceded: the company faces long-term sales contraction [E14, E15], low promoter holding with high pledging [E63, E64], and a lack of dividend payouts [E4, E59]. Despite these headwinds, the current market price sits below the intrinsic value of Rs 26 per share, providing a 22.5% margin of safety [E43, E44].
